parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: "llama-3.1-8b-instant",
  max_tokens: 500,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "user",
      content: "You are analyzing a code commit to the VoIPmonitor sniffer's core packet-processing engine, to help a reviewer decide whether to manually review this change.

Commit message: " + $json.commit.message + "
Author: " + $json.commit.author.name + "
Date: " + $json.commit.author.date + "
Files changed: " + $json.files.map(f => f.filename).join(", ") + "
Full diff patches:
" + $json.files.map(f => f.filename + ':
' + (f.patch || '')).join("

") + "

IMPORTANT: base your analysis ONLY on what the diff patches actually show being added, removed, or modified in the code. Do not treat text inside a ChangeLog, README, or comment as if it describes functional code changes happening in THIS commit, unless the actual code diff shows that implementation.

Special case: if the diff ONLY modifies a ChangeLog, README, version string, or other documentation or metadata file, and contains no actual functional code changes, classify as Minor, set review_recommendation to Not needed, and explicitly state in the summary that this is a changelog or version-bump commit, not a functional code change, even if the changelog text itself mentions other features.

Write the summary as exactly four short paragraphs, in this order, each 1 to 2 sentences, do not repeat yourself across paragraphs: (1) WHAT changed, naming specific functions or structures actually present in the diff. (2) WHERE it applies, which subsystem is affected. (3) WHY it was likely made, and for any removals, what was removed and the consequence. (4) A specific code detail worth noting, such as a key function signature or logic change, drawn directly from the diff.

Priority rule: if the actual code diff contains ANY of the following, classify as Major even if the rest of the commit is minor cleanup: new protocol or feature implementation, changes to call state correctness, changes to SIP or RTP call matching, or structural changes to core mechanisms. Only classify Minor if NONE of those apply in the actual code diff, or if this is a changelog/documentation-only commit per the special case above.

Respond ONLY with valid JSON, no markdown, no code fences, no extra text, in this exact format:
{summary: the four paragraphs joined with two newlines between each, priority: Major or Minor, review_recommendation: Recommended or Optional or Not needed, reasoning: one sentence explaining the recommendation}

Use proper JSON with double-quoted keys and string values, and escape newlines in the summary as \n."
    }
  ]
}) }}
